en.summary: Despite accumulating over 1,000 stars, the repository shows signs of stagnation with no updates for over four months and open issues raising concerns about a lack of real substance. The steep discrepancy between high stars and very few watchers points to passive bookmarking rather than genuine engagement.
signals: High star count (1,138) paired with an unusually low watcher count (9)
No repository activity or pushes for 123 days
Community feedback indicates core content (SKILL.md) is thin and mostly composed of external wiki links
